calls.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite sheet, actual drawings to be sliced and played, not a mockup or storyboard. Locked character reference: attached original brown SHADOW WEASEL. Preserve exactly its rich chestnut fur, cream muzzle and belly stripe, amber eyes, tiny round ears, long low flexible mustelid body, thick tapered tail, painterly shading and dark outlines, same 3/4 left-facing camera and proportions. Create ONE square 4 columns by 4 rows sheet with precisely SIXTEEN equal square cells, reading left to right then next row. Transparent background with no grid, no labels, no shadows, no scenery. All cells have one whole character at IDENTICAL art scale, ground baseline and fixed center; broad neutral body should occupy about 80% cell width, plenty of padding, no clipping. This is a contiguous animation of curling up, no rolling or flipping. Every drawing must be the SAME WEASEL, not cats or foxes. Frame 1 reference neutral crouch; 2 nose turns inward and chest lowers; 3 neck bends inward towards own belly, front paws begin tuck; 4 shoulders curl and tail begins sweeping towards front; 5 long torso bends into a C shape with tucked front legs and hindquarters anchored; 6 tail wraps around outside as back rounds; 7 nearly round compact curled mustelid with recognizable small face tucked into cream belly, thick tail around perimeter; 8 fully curled round resting pose, feet folded beneath, face partly visible; 9 same curled pose for hold; 10 head starts lifting out while tail relaxes; 11 tail unwraps and front paws extend; 12 torso unfolds halfway with head reaching left; 13 back lengthens and forepaws plant; 14 returns near exact neutral; 15 exact neutral reference pose; 16 exact neutral with only very slight relaxed chest breath. Smooth coherent anatomy and gradual changes in EVERY consecutive frame. The curl remains on same ground spot with real overlap between tail/body/head, no body scaling, no fade, no duplicates except the explicitly held curl. Maintain the original illustrated fidelity. Maximize sprite detail, prefer 2048x2048 sheet.
